front.transcription: ENTER/EXIT INFILTRATION SITE Move between an Infiltration city and the ENTRANCE room of its Infiltration site. Your alias must match the city’s affiliation.

CHANGE ALIAS
In a city with a safehouse, open your passport to a different page.

ALUMINUM SALESPERSON:
Once per turn, as an action, you may take a City card from another player in your city.

CHANGE ALIAS
In a city with a safehouse, open your passport to a different page.

SPECIALIZATIONS
Box 0007-5f
Add a specialization to each neutral alias.

CARGO PILOT:
As an action, you may move to a city with a safehouse.

ELECTRICIAN:
When you do the Identify Target City action, reveal the required cards instead of discarding them.

CHANGE ALIAS
RULE M
While in a city with a safehouse, open your passport to a different page. This switches the cover occupation, specialization, assets, and liabilities available to your character. Your hand of cards and your Action tokens are not affected when you do the Change Alias action.

ACTION TOKENS
RULE E
For each Action token you spend, you may do 1 additional action during the Do Actions step of your turn.
At the end of the Mop Up step on your turn, if you have more than 3 Action tokens, discard down to 3.

PLASTICS TECHNICIAN:
If you begin your turn with this alias, take 1 Action token.

SPECIALIZATIONS
Box 0007-4f
Add a specialization to each neutral alias.

TRANSPORT CREW:
On your turn, whenever you move to a new city, you may move any teams in your city with you.
